text: dsh-adaptive-model-router 是为 DSH 提供的自适应模型路由插件，按每轮请求复杂度在经济路线和高质量路线间选择。它检查消息长度或配置关键词来决定初始路线；默认配置使用 DeepSeek Flash 与 Pro。达到设定步数或连续工具失败时，会在本轮单向升级到高质量路线；新一轮重新判断。它也会同步系统提示中的 provider 和 model，并能保留插件路线之外的显式模型选择。适合希望简单请求走经济模型、复杂请求或工具失败后切换高质量模型的 DSH 用户。需配置两条路线的 provider 和 model。

dsh-adaptive-model-router routes DSH turns between economy and quality models. Message length or keywords choose the initial route; later steps or tool failures can upgrade it. New turns are evaluated again. Configure both provider and model routes.
想让简单请求走便宜模型，复杂问题自动切换到更强的模型。
DSH 遇到长问题、代码审查或迁移任务时，能否自动改用高质量模型？
Can I move a DSH turn to a stronger model automatically after repeated tool errors?
dsh-adaptive-model-router 的功能「按复杂度选择模型」：每轮开始时检查消息长度和配置关键词，匹配复杂请求就选择高质量路线，否则选择经济路线。
dsh-adaptive-model-router feature “Upgrade”: later steps or repeated tool failures move the turn to the quality model.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · dsh-adaptive-model-router：Deterministic per-turn adaptive model routing for DeepSeek Harness. Simple work uses an economy model; complex work and turns that stop making progress upgrade to a quality model.

The router does not call another model to classify the request. Routing is local, synchronous, reproducible, and adds no tokens or provider requests.

The package targets and has been composed against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2`.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:icyaaaww/dsh-adaptive-model-router
```

The package ships runnable ESM JavaScript, so a GitHub installation requires no `prepare` build or pnpm build-script allowance.

For this local checkout, run from its parent directory:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-adaptive-model-router
```

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Configuration：The included bundle defaults to DeepSeek Flash and Pro:

```yaml
- id: adaptive-model-router
  name: dsh-adaptive-model-router
  config:
    economy:

Each route also accepts optional `reasoningEffort` and `maxTokens`. A selected route without `reasoningEffort` clears the previous model's effort so the selected adapter can apply its own default; an omitted route `maxTokens` preserves an explicit request limit. Temperature, stop sequences, and every other request field remain unchanged.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Routing behavior：At the first admitted step of each turn, the router selects Quality when the entering text reaches `inputCharsThreshold` or contains a configured case-insensitive keyword. Otherwise it selects Economy.

Within that turn routing has hysteresis: it may upgrade to Quality but never downgrade. It upgrades when either condition is met:

- The zero-based request step reaches `upgradeAfterStep`.
- Consecutive non-excluded tool failures reach `upgradeAfterToolFailures`.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Routing behavior：A successful tracked tool resets only the failure counter; it does not downgrade a turn already upgraded. A new turn starts a fresh decision and may return to Economy.

With `preserveUnknownSelection: true`, requests currently targeting neither configured route pass through unchanged. This keeps an explicit user selection, another provider, or a specialized vision model from being silently replaced. Set it to `false` only when this plugin should own every conversation request.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Model Experience：The router changes the logged request configuration and keeps the system prompt's `provider` and `model` template variables aligned with that route. It injects no prompt, tool, message, or hidden model-visible instruction. Existing `request/header` records make every route change durable and visible to replay, telemetry, and clients.
dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Token effect：The plugin itself adds zero tokens. Savings depend on how many requests move to the economy route and provider pricing.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · KV cache effect：Changing provider or model starts a different provider cache identity. Per-turn hysteresis prevents oscillation inside one turn, while a new user turn may deliberately select a different route.

dsh-adaptive-model-router README · Limitations：- Keyword and length rules estimate complexity; they do not measure answer quality.
- Tool failures produced by policy denial also count unless their tool is excluded.
- Already-running parallel tools can settle after the route has upgraded.
- The router does not verify model catalog membership; the selected provider owns availability diagnostics.
- Cost reporting is not included. Compare telemetry before and after deployment to tune thresholds.
